dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 01, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**

A dominant performance from Kevin Gausman led the Toronto Blue Jays to a 5-1 win over the St. Louis Cardinals. Gausman tossed 5.2 innings, allowing just one earned run, while striking out four. George Springer drove in two runs on two hits for the Blue Jays. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. also had a key hit, scoring on a single by Alejandro Kirk.

**Mariners Take Down Twins in Seattle**

Logan Gilbert pitched 7 scoreless innings, striking out six and allowing just three earned runs, as the Seattle Mariners edged the Minnesota Twins 4-3. Randy Arozarena homered and drove in a run for the Twins, but it wasn't enough to overcome Gilbert's strong outing. Andrés Muñoz earned the win in relief.

**Rays Shut Down White Sox**

Drew Rasmussen tossed a gem, striking out 10 over 6 innings, as the Tampa Bay Rays blanked the Chicago White Sox 1-0. Nick Fortes drove in the lone run for the White Sox on a single in the top of the 8th.

**Marlins Come from Behind to Beat Mets**

Javier Sanoja homered and drove in two runs, leading the Miami Marlins to a 6-2 win over the New York Mets. Tyler Phillips earned the win in relief, and Lake Bachar recorded the save.

**Pirates Edge Reds**

Jose Trevino homered and drove in a run, leading the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 4-1 win over the Cincinnati Reds. Carmen Mlodzinski pitched 3 scoreless innings, striking out four, in relief.

**Phillies Blank Orioles**

Cristopher Sánchez pitched 6 scoreless innings, striking out 11, as the Philadelphia Phillies shut out the Baltimore Orioles 5-0. Justin Crawford drove in two runs on a single.

**Astros Walk Off Rangers**

Elias Díaz homered and drove in two runs, but the Texas Rangers came up short in a 5-4 loss to the Houston Astros. Steven Okert earned the win in relief, and Josh Hader recorded the save.

**Diamondbacks Outlast Guardians**

Geraldo Perdomo homered and drove in three runs, leading the Arizona Diamondbacks to a 12-8 win over the Cleveland Guardians. Parker Messick pitched 4.1 scoreless innings, striking out six, in relief.

**Braves Blow Out Nationals**

Martín Pérez pitched 7 scoreless innings, striking out six, as the Atlanta Braves routed the Washington Nationals 8-3. Dominic Smith homered and drove in two runs for the Nationals.

**Cubs Shut Down Yankees**

David Peterson pitched 6.1 scoreless innings, striking out eight, as the Chicago Cubs blanked the New York Yankees 5-2. Spencer Jones homered and drove in a run for the Yankees.

**Rockies Rout Royals**

Hunter Goodman homered twice and drove in five runs, leading the Colorado Rockies to a 12-6 win over the Kansas City Royals. Ryan Feltner earned the win in relief.

**Padres Edge Giants**

Osleivis Basabe homered and drove in four runs, leading the San Diego Padres to a 6-5 win over the San Francisco Giants. Mason Miller earned the win in relief.

**Red Sox Edge Dodgers**

Ceddanne Rafaela homered twice and drove in two runs, leading the Boston Red Sox to a 3-2 win over the Los Angeles Dodgers. Payton Tolle pitched 6 scoreless innings, striking out seven, in relief.

**Brewers Shut Down Angels**

Chad Patrick pitched 2 scoreless innings, striking out five, as the Milwaukee Brewers blanked the Los Angeles Angels 3-1. Jake Bauers homered and drove in a run for the Brewers.

**Tigers Outlast Athletics**

Henry Bolte homered and drove in three runs, leading the Detroit Tigers to an 8-6 win over the Athletics. Framber Valdez pitched 7 scoreless innings, striking out six, for the Tigers.
